endorsements.quote: The development of a widely accepted reference standards is critical for advancing AI-based tools for AMD screening.
For AI development, diverse age groups should be included during model training and testing, because screening age thresholds will vary across health care systems and countries.

unlisted_practices: Adopt the Beckman classification as the level 1 image-based reference standard for labeling AMD in validation of AI screening algorithms.
Incorporate volumetric OCT alongside color fundus photography when labeling drusen, geographic atrophy, and neovascular AMD for the reference standard.
Use color fundus photography as the reference for drusen size classification when drusen are visible on both methods, and require more than 125 μm on OCT for classification to avoid overcalling.
Benchmark AI models that use OCT hyperreflective foci as inputs against color-defined pigment labels to stay consistent with the reference standard.
Configure AI referral outputs to refer urgently (within 1 week) for neovascular AMD and nonurgently for geographic atrophy and intermediate AMD.

screen.reason: This is a modified Delphi expert consensus study establishing reference standards and labeling guidelines for AI validation in age-related macular degeneration screening.
